\documentclass{article}

{\bf Proposition 9.2.3} \quad Let $p\geq 7$, then\\
(1) Each tree is a graph,

(2) each path is a tree.


{\bf Proof}:\quad (1) A tree is a graph by definition. (2) A path is a tree.
